reason: This is a cross-layer timeout/behavior change, not a local fix. It propagates query `max_execution_time` from session/distsql/executor into PD `GetRegion` RPCs, touching point-get and coprocessor paths that are on critical read/query execution routes. That can change runtime correctness and user-visible query behavior broadly via deadline propagation, cancellation, partial timeout budgeting, and error surfacing. The blast radius is high enough to justify a blocker/high-focused deep review.
